title: Bluegrass vs. Fescue: Why Bluegrass Still Wins in Chicago’s Climate
intro: As a homeowner in Chicago, you understand the unique challenges our local environment presents. From the biting cold of winter to the humid heat of summer, and the clay-rich soils beneath our feet, cultivating a lush, green lawn isn't just about throwing down some seed and hoping for the best. It requires a strategic approach, an understanding of turfgrass science, and often, professional expertise. When it comes to establishing a new lawn or renovating an existing one, the choice often boils down to two formidable contenders: Kentucky Bluegrass and Tall Fescue. While Tall Fescue has its merits, for the quintessential Chicago lawn – dense, vibrant, and resilient – Kentucky Bluegrass consistently emerges as the champion. In this comprehensive guide, we'll delve into why professional Kentucky bluegrass sod installation offers the unparalleled beauty and durability that Chicago homeowners desire, perfectly suited to our distinct climate and soil conditions.
